sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Market Kurly (마켓컬리, 컬리)
  • 한 줄 정체성: 한국 새벽배송의 시작 — 프리미엄 식료품 큐레이션
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "내일의 식탁을 오늘 밤에 — 신선함, 큐레이션, 새벽 도착"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: Kurly Purple(#5F0080) + 샛별배송 배지 + 'Kurly Only' 자체 브랜드
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 프리미엄, 새벽배송, 큐레이션
  • 무드 설명: 보라 헤더 + 흰 캔버스 + 식료품 컬러풀 사진. 새벽배송 배지가 신뢰 신호로 강조된다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Round (6~10px)
  • 평면성: Subtle
sections.④:
• 한글 Pretendard, 영문 -apple-system
  • Display 32/800/1.15 / H1 22/800/1.2 / H2 17/700/1.27 / H3 14/700/1.3
  • Body 13/500 / Small 12/500 / Caption 11/700
sections.⑦:
--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
--shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
--shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
--shadow-xl: 0 16px 32px rgba(95,0,128,0.30);
sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 700 14px/1 Pretendard,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }

Input

.input { background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 11px 14px; font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit; }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--border-focus); }

Card

.card { background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 12px; }
.product .img { aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: var(--radius-md); position: relative; }
.product .brand { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-top: 6px; }
.product h3 { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; margin: 2px 0 4px; }
.product .price-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; }
.product .pct { font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-primary-500); font-weight: 800; }
.product .price { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; }

Badge / 샛별배송

.tag { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; }
.tag-saetbyeol { background: #5F0080; color: #fff; }
.tag-only { background: #fff; color: #5F0080; border: 1px solid #5F0080; }
.tag-solid { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-subtle { background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-primary); }

Navigation

.topnav { padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.topnav .brand { font-weight: 900; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }
sections.⑪: 1. 샛별배송 배지를 brand purple 외 다른 색으로 변경 금지 2. brand purple을 destructive 액션에 사용 금지 3. Kurly Only 배지를 임의 위치 변경 금지 — 좌상단 표준 4. 본문 폰트 weight 400 이하 금지 5. 가격 영역에서 할인%/가격 분리 표기 금지
sections.⑫:
<style>
  body { margin: 0; font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-subtle); }
  .kurly-demo, .kurly-demo * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .kurly-demo { min-height: 100vh; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .kurly-header { background: var(--bg-base); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .kurly-utility { max-width: 1050px; height: 34px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-md, 16px); color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
  .kurly-utility strong { color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .kurly-head { max-width: 1050px; min-height: 72px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(260px, 400px) 1fr; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-xl, 32px); }
  .kurly-wordmark { font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; color: var(--color-primary-500); font-size: 36px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.07em; }
  .kurly-search { height: 46px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-primary-500); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 0 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 14px; }
  .kurly-search svg { margin-left: auto; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .kurly-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-lg, 24px); color: var(--text-primary); }
  .kurly-nav { max-width: 1050px; height: 54px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 54px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .kurly-nav .category { color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .kurly-nav .delivery { margin-left: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-full); padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; }
  .kurly-nav .delivery strong { color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .kurly-main { max-width: 1050px; margin: 0 auto; padding: var(--space-xl, 32px) 0 var(--space-3xl, 64px); }
  .kurly-hero { min-height: 360px; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); overflow: hidden; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr; background: linear-gradient(112deg, var(--color-primary-50) 0%, #F8EEF8 54%, #FFF1E1 54%, #F8E0C4 100%); position: relative; }
  .kurly-hero-copy { padding: 56px 16px 48px 56px; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .kurly-eyebrow { margin: 14px 0 8px; color: var(--color-primary-500); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; }
  .kurly-hero h1 { margin: 0; max-width: 540px; font-size: clamp(32px, 4.1vw, 52px); line-height: 1.13; letter-spacing: -0.045em; }
  .kurly-hero p { margin: 18px 0 26px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; }
  .kurly-hero .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 46px; text-decoration: none; }
  .kurly-visual { min-height: 360px; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .kurly-visual::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 290px; height: 290px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); box-shadow: 0 30px 70px rgba(95,0,128,.10); }
  .kurly-visual svg { width: min(390px, 92%); height: auto; position: relative; z-index: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 24px 18px rgba(68,29,10,.14)); }
  .kurly-benefits { padding-top: var(--space-xl, 32px); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--space-md, 16px); }
  .feature-card { min-height: 190px; padding: 26px; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: transform var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out), box-shadow var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out); }
  .feature-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
  .feature-icon { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .feature-card h2 { margin: 18px 0 8px; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.3; }
  .feature-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; }
  .feature-card .feature-link { display: inline-block; margin-top: 16px; color: var(--color-primary-500); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .kurly-utility { display: none; }
    .kurly-head { min-height: 118px; padding: 14px 18px; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 12px; }
    .kurly-wordmark { font-size: 28px; }
    .kurly-search { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; width: 100%; }
    .kurly-actions { gap: 14px; }
    .kurly-nav { height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; gap: 24px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; }
    .kurly-nav .delivery { display: none; }
    .kurly-main { padding: 0 0 36px; }
    .kurly-hero { border-radius: 0; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .kurly-hero-copy { padding: 38px 24px 12px; }
    .kurly-visual { min-height: 240px; }
    .kurly-benefits { padding: 18px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
